ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CAM can calculate toolpaths automatically, but an operator still steps in when a workpiece is misaligned or chips jam the machine.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 177,100 Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Operators employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 158,100 by 2034, a net decline of about 19,000 jobs, with about 13,500 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $50,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Operators, but it will take over more programming and material handling. CAM and robots automate code generation and workpiece loading. Operators shift from pressing buttons to monitoring cuts, adjusting offsets, overseeing multiple machines, and handling exceptions. People who only start cycles face pressure, while operators with multi-machine and basic programming skills become more valuable.

ai_s3_list: Clamping and alignment: a machine cannot tell when the workpiece is misaligned.
Offset adjustment: operators judge wear while watching the cut.
Exception response: chip jams and unusual sounds need a person on site.
Multi-machine rounds: people monitor several machines at once.
First-piece judgment: people decide whether a part is out of tolerance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems absorb more programming and material handling, but people still handle clamping, offset adjustments, and exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces button pressing and material loading, not the work of monitoring cuts and adjusting offsets. Operators who oversee multiple machines and understand basic programming become scarcer. Those who only start cycles face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in CNC machining or moldmaking through vocational study. Spend time on machines and measuring tools. Pure machine watching is shrinking, so learn programming and basic processes early.
Advance from watching one machine to overseeing multiple machines and learning programming. Practice offset adjustment and first-piece judgment, then move toward CNC programming or process work.
Show machining accuracy and the number of machines you have overseen. Name the materials and tolerances you have handled. Factories value consistent, experienced operators.
Hire for offset-adjustment and multi-machine skills, not physical strength alone. Operators who can program independently merit a higher job level.

ai_s7_trends: Automated loading makes multi-machine oversight standard.
CAM and probes automate more programming and first-piece work.
Operators with multi-machine and basic programming skills become more sought after.

Don’t just be attracted by the glamor of the word “jewelry”.

While improving the craftsmanship, I also added CAD modeling, 3D printing wax models, and laser welding. Moving towards high-end customization and repair, these two pieces of AI and machines are the most difficult to replace and have the highest unit price per customer.

First, go to a workshop or jewelry brand as an apprentice to understand the real process. Don't just spend money on equipment. Those with an art or metalworking background will have an advantage when changing careers; bringing your own works to the interview is more convincing than any certificate.

High-end customization workshops recommend "manual + digital" as the screening criteria: people who know CAD and are willing to sit back and polish their craftsmanship are the most scarce. Don't use exorbitant salaries to attract piece-rate mass production positions. Retain core talents through long-term training and sharing of works.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce thousands of test values in seconds, but a person who understands the data must still decide whether an abnormal result reflects an instrument problem, a specimen problem, or a true patient emergency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 351,200 medical and clinical laboratory technicians employed in 2024, projected to rise to 357,200 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 6,000 jobs, with roughly 22,600 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $61,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace the entire laboratory-technician occupation, but it will absorb a substantial share of mechanical work. Fully automated lines, AI cell recognition, and automatic result verification are taking over loading, reading, and reporting. Remaining work includes specimen-quality control, abnormal-result retesting, instrument troubleshooting, quality control, and critical-value communication. As machines become smarter, this corrective work becomes more valuable.

ai_s3_list: Specimen-quality judgment: inspect visually for hemolysis, lipemia, and clots before trusting the data.
Abnormal-result retesting decisions: when a value is implausible, know whether to inspect the instrument or specimen first.
Instrument troubleshooting: locate faults quickly and provide manual backup when an instrument stops with an alarm.
Critical-value communication: reach the physician immediately and explain severity clearly.
Quality control and compliance: protect result reliability through internal quality control and external quality assessment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score reflects a highly standardized occupation with substantial repetitive work and genuinely high AI exposure. Automated lines and intelligent order review are eliminating a large share of operational workload.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean the occupation disappears. Pure operation disappears, while judgment remains. As AI completes more routine results, laboratories need more people who review abnormalities, manage quality control, and understand instrument principles. Moving from operator to result gatekeeper turns medium-to-high exposure into high value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose a medical-laboratory program that qualifies graduates for laboratory-technician certification, and do not study operation alone. Build strong foundations in data analysis, instrument principles, and quality control because these resist replacement in the AI era. Independent laboratories and laboratories at community hospitals provide stable employment outlets.

Do not settle for knowing how to start an instrument. Deepen quality control, retesting, instrument maintenance, and result interpretation, then advance toward supervising technologist or laboratory quality lead. After AI order review arrives, people who handle complex specimens and difficult results remain most secure.

People with biology or chemistry backgrounds can change careers by earning relevant laboratory credentials. Prepare interview examples involving independently handled abnormal results and quality-control participation. Independent laboratories are friendlier to newcomers and can provide initial experience.

After automated equipment goes live, laboratories should focus hiring on people who review results, manage quality control, and troubleshoot faults. Job descriptions should prioritize quality-control and retesting experience and provide technicians with advancement paths.

别满足于「会开机」。把质控、复检、仪器维护和结果解读练深，往主管技师、实验室质量负责人方向走；AI 审单落地后，能扛住复杂样本和疑难结果的人最稳。

自动化设备上线后，检验科的招聘重心应转向「会审结果、会管质控、会处理故障」的人。建议在岗位描述里写清楚有质控和复检经验优先，给技师留上升通道。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,094,500 secondary school teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,076,700 by 2034, a net loss of about 17,800 jobs, with about 66,200 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $64,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace secondary school teachers, but it will change the manual burden of lesson preparation and grading. AI can substantially assist with lesson plans, slides, tests, assignment grading, and performance analysis. Classroom management, student development, understanding learning needs, and homeroom responsibilities still require a person to be present.

Assignment and test grading: automatic scoring for objective questions and assisted scoring for subjective responses
Automated grade statistics and learning reports
Bulk generation of notices, parent letters, comments, and other documents
ai_s3_list: Classroom management: maintaining the attention of forty or fifty students requires an in-person presence.
Adolescent development: romance, rebellion, and disengagement each require tact and sincerity.
Family-school communication: explaining that a child's condition has changed in a way parents will hear is a skill.
Understanding learning needs: data shows where a student went wrong, but people must discover why and how to help.
Role modeling and presence: students often remember a teacher's words, not a particular problem.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means desk work accounts for nearly half the occupation. AI is rapidly taking over lesson preparation, grading, exam analysis, and documentation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI frees teachers from repetitive work and creates more time for student development, which parents and schools value most. Scripted instruction faces pressure, while teachers who use AI for differentiated learning become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: While studying education, develop subject expertise and adolescent psychology rather than only practicing test questions. Teachers who analyze learning and differentiate instruction are more valuable in the AI era. Pursue homeroom-teacher shadowing during internships.

Use AI as a teaching assistant for preparation, question writing, and grading, then spend the saved time on the classroom and individual support. Build experience in teaching research, assessment design, and master-teacher studios instead of becoming only a problem-explaining machine.

Subject expertise + teaching credentials are firm requirements, so complete both first. Career changers with industry experience should use that advantage; vocational education, general technology, and integrated practice increasingly need teachers with practical experience.

Do not hire teachers based only on written-test scores. Use teaching demonstrations to assess classroom management and interviews to assess educational philosophy. Schools should retain candidates who use AI for preparation and assessment while investing time in students.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 把老师从「重复劳动」里解放出来，省下的时间正好用在育人上——这正是家长和学校最看重的。真正被挤压的是「只会照本宣科」的讲授岗，会借 AI 做分层教学的老师反而更值钱。

把 AI 当教学助理：备课、命题、批改都用起来，把时间花在课堂和个别辅导上。同时往教研、命题、名师工作室方向积累，别只当「讲题机器」。
学科功底 + 教资是硬门槛，先把这两样补齐。有企业经验的转岗者别浪费优势——职业教育、通用技术、综合实践课越来越需要「会做事」的老师。
招老师别只看笔试分数，试讲看课堂把控，面谈看育人理念。会用 AI 备课命题、又愿意花时间在学生身上的候选人，是学校最该留的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can match a client with ten potentially applicable assistance policies in seconds, but social workers must visit, talk, and listen to understand whether an older adult will accept help and what a family needs most urgently.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 81,000 social workers, all other, were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 84,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,100 jobs, with approximately 7,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $69,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace social workers, but it will substantially reduce administrative burdens. Case records, policy matching, document organization, and statistics can be delegated to AI, returning more time to visits and relationship building. The core of social work is people. Accurate in-home assessments, trust with families in hardship, and negotiation among multiple resources occur through real visits and cannot be replaced by machines.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent forms support needs assessment and case setup
Speech transcription automatically generates visit notes
Big-data analysis of community service needs
Remote-visit tools cover distant regions
ai_s2_auto: Automated organization of case records and service reports
Automatic matching of assistance policies to clients
Digital visit data and records
Automated generation of service-outcome statistical reports
ai_s3_list: In-home assessment: judge reality beyond the form.
Trust building: help people in hardship feel willing to speak.
Multi-party negotiation: coordinate among neighborhood authorities, hospitals, and families.
Emergency response: remain calm at the scene of an unexpected crisis.
Values-based judgment: balance policy requirements with human circumstances.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI is taking over much of the occupation's documentation and information processing, while social workers create their core value through in-home assessment, trust building, and multi-party coordination. These are areas where AI performs poorly and errors are unacceptable. Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk; social workers' time will shift toward the professional relationships that create real value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk still brings change. Social workers who use digital tools can serve more cases and produce more professional reports. Those who remain with manual spreadsheets and refuse to learn systems will increasingly fall behind the pace of project management.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study social work or sociology, complete extensive internships in communities and social service organizations, and earn social worker qualifications. Build a strong foundation in human-centered courses while mastering data tools. Both are standard capabilities for future social workers.

Use case management systems and AI documentation tools to reduce paperwork and return time to visits. Work toward project supervisor and practice supervisor roles while practicing self-care, because burnout is as significant as other pressures in social work.

People with nursing, education, or administrative backgrounds generally transition smoothly into social work. First earn a social worker credential, then start as a project assistant in a community or social service organization. In interviews, understanding of a specific population and actual field-visit experience are more compelling than credentials alone.

Do not use AI tools to reduce social worker headcount. Use them to reduce paperwork and expand service reach. Reasonable caseloads, supervision support, and structured pay progression are necessary to retain professionals who deliver meaningful work.

Use big data to analyze community service needs
Video visits with clients in distant areas

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over documentation and policy matching, returning social workers' time to home visits and service.
Population aging and community-level governance sustain growth in social work roles.
Digitalization and professional supervision advance together, increasing professionalization in social work.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年其他社会工作者在岗约 8.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.41 万人，净增约 0.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.70 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.95 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代社工，但会大幅减轻「事务性」负担：个案记录、政策匹配、材料整理、数据统计都能交给 AI，让社工把更多时间还给探访和关系建立。但社工工作的核心是「人」——入户评估的真实性、困境家庭信任的建立、多方资源的斡旋，这些都发生在真实的走访里，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 智能表单辅助需求评估建档
语音转写自动生成走访纪要
社区服务需求大数据分析
远程探访工具覆盖偏远地区

救助政策自动匹配服务对象

ai_s3_list: 入户评估：表格之外的真实情况判断。
信任建立：让困难人群愿意开口。
多方斡旋：街道、医院、家庭之间的协调。
应急处理：突发危机现场的冷静应对。
价值观判断：政策与人情的平衡。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的「文书与信息处理」部分正被 AI 大幅接管，但社工的核心价值在入户评估、信任建立和多方协调上——这些是 AI 最不擅长、也最不能出错的部分。中高曝光不等于高风险，社工的时间将被重新配置到真正值钱的专业关系上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：会用数字化工具的社工能服务更多个案、产出更专业的报告；而停留在手工表格、拒绝学习系统的社工，会发现自己越来越跟不上项目管理的节奏。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 建议读社会工作或社会学专业，在校多去社区和社工机构实习，考社会工作师资格。把「人」的课程学扎实，同时掌握数据工具——这两条腿是未来社工的标配。
把个案管理系统、AI 文书工具用起来，减轻表格负担，把时间还给探访。往项目主管、督导方向走，同时注意自我照顾——社工的倦怠风险不比压力小。
有护理、教育、行政背景的转行社工相对顺：先考社会工作师证，从社区或社工机构的项目助理做起。面试展示你对具体人群的理解和实际走访经验，比证书更打动人。
别用 AI 工具削减社工编制，用它减轻文书负担、扩大服务半径。给社工合理的个案量、督导支持和薪资梯度，才能留住真正能做事的人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 服务报告与纪要自动生成
自动匹配适用救助政策
大数据分析社区服务需求
视频探访偏远地区对象
志愿者与物资需求对接
项目进度与成效可视化

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管文书与政策匹配，社工时间回归入户与服务。
老龄化与基层治理推动社工岗位持续增长。
数字化与专业督导并行，社工职业化水平提升。

body: 社会工作者（其他，Social Workers, All Other）运用社会工作专业方法，为老年人、儿童、残障人士、困难家庭等群体提供评估、个案管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在几秒里帮你匹配出十项可能适用的救助政策，但「这位老人愿不愿意接受帮助、这个家庭最着急的到底是什么」——这些得靠社工上门聊、坐下来听。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate collector area, lay out piping, and report faults, but installers still have to mount the collectors on the roof and weld the pipes securely.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 504,500 installers and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 527,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,700 jobs, with about 44,000 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $63,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace solar thermal installers, but it will change the structure of their work. AI will handle system selection and design, energy calculations, quoting and scheduling, and operational monitoring, shifting installers from following drawings toward design support, on-site installation, and intelligent commissioning. What remains irreplaceable is the physical work of installing rooftop equipment and piping, the on-site craft of welding and commissioning, and hands-on troubleshooting of system faults. AI can calculate, but people must install, weld, and repair.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted system design and piping layout
Factory-prefabricated modules reduce on-site installation work
Rising demand for integrated heat pump, solar PV, and energy storage system installation
Widespread adoption of smart controllers and remote commissioning
ai_s2_auto: Automated system selection and energy calculations
Quote and project schedule management
Remote monitoring of operating data
Digital installation records and acceptance documentation
ai_s3_list: On-site rooftop installation: machinery cannot perform hoisting, fastening, and waterproofing on the roof.
Piping connections and welding craft: secure joints and tight welds determine system life.
System commissioning and troubleshooting: diagnosing abnormal parameters, pressure, and temperature requires on-site experience.
Coordination across trades: schedules and quality depend on people coordinating with electricians, welders, and construction crews.
Safe-work judgment: self-protection on roofs, at height, and around energized equipment depends on procedures and awareness.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means design and process tasks in this occupation are being automated, with systems handling selection, scheduling, and monitoring.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. As AI takes over design tasks, installers need stronger system knowledge and broader integrated-energy expertise, making on-site installation and commissioning skills scarcer. Pure build-to-print work faces pressure, while technical installers with integrated-energy expertise and multiple credentials command a clear premium.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study HVAC, electromechanical systems, or renewable energy at a vocational school or college, and earn welding, electrical, and work-at-height credentials while enrolled. Renewable energy installation benefits from supportive policy and offers a clear career path.

Learn heat pumps, solar PV and storage, and smart control systems, advancing from solar thermal installation to integrated energy installation. Multiple credentials keep work available even in the off-season.

Career changers with welding, plumbing, electrical, or HVAC backgrounds can learn quickly. Earn special-operation credentials before joining an installation crew, and describe the systems you have installed, credentials you hold, and project acceptance rate on your resume.

When hiring installers, look beyond age and physical strength to credentials and integrated-energy capabilities. Installers who understand design and selection and can lead crews are the backbone of renewable energy installation teams.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Collector area calculation and piping layout
Pressure testing, temperature measurement, and parameter verification
Scheduling, work reporting, and acceptance photos

ai_s7_trends: Heat pumps, solar PV, and solar thermal are converging into integrated energy systems. Installers are transitioning from solar thermal alone to integrated energy installation, and cross-disciplinary skills command a clear premium.

Factory prefabrication and smart commissioning are becoming widespread, reducing pure on-site construction work while maintaining steady on-site demand for welding, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
Energy-efficiency retrofits and carbon-reduction policies continue to drive demand, creating a long-term shortage of certified installers who understand design and can lead crews.

body: Solar thermal installers and technicians install, commission, and maintain solar collector systems, including hoisting collectors, connecting piping, and configuring tanks and controls. This technical installation occupation supports renewable hot-water and heating systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate collector area, lay out piping, and report faults, but installers still have to mount the collectors on the roof and weld the pipes securely.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你算集热面积、排管路、报故障，但把集热板架上屋顶、把管路焊严实的，还得是安装工。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安装工技术员在岗约 50.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 52.72 万人，净增约 2.27 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.30 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代光热安装工，但会改变工作结构。系统选型设计、能耗计算、报价排程、运行监测都被 AI 接手，安装工从「照图施工」转向「设计辅助 + 现场安装 + 智能调试」。真正不可替代的是屋顶与管路的体力安装、焊接调试的现场手艺，以及系统故障的实地排查——AI 能算，但装、焊、修要靠人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助系统设计与管道布局
工厂预制化模块减少现场安装量
热泵与光伏储能综合系统安装需求上升
智能控制器与远程调试普及
ai_s2_auto: 系统选型与能耗计算自动化
报价与项目排程管理
运行数据远程监测
安装记录与验收资料电子化
ai_s3_list: 屋顶现场安装：吊装、固定、防水处理，机器上不了屋面。
管路连接与焊接手艺：接得牢不牢、焊得严不严，决定系统寿命。
系统调试与故障排查：参数、压力、温度异常，现场判断靠经验。
多工种协作：与电工、焊工、土建配合，工期和质量靠人协调。
安全作业判断：屋面、高空、带电环境的自我保护，靠规程和意识。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的设计与流程工作正被自动化——选型、排程、监测都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为设计环节被 AI 接管，安装工被要求「更会看系统、更懂综合能源」，现场安装与调试手艺反而更稀缺。真正被挤压的是纯照图施工环节，会综合能源、持多证的技术安装工溢价明显。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读暖通、机电、新能源相关职校或大专，在校把焊工、电工、高处作业证考下来。新能源安装是政策风口，职业路径清晰。
把热泵、光伏储能、智能控制系统学起来，从「装光热」升级为「综合能源安装」。多证在手，淡季也不愁活。
有焊接、水电、暖通背景的转行者上手快。先考特种作业证再进安装队，简历上多写「装过哪些系统、持有哪些证、项目验收率」。
招安装工别只看年龄体力，要看持证和综合能源能力。会设计选型、能带队的安装工，是新能源安装团队的骨干。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 集热面积计算、管路布局

ai_s7_trends: 热泵、光伏与光热走向综合能源系统，安装工从单一光热向综合能源安装转型，复合技能溢价明显。
工厂预制化与智能调试普及，现场纯施工量下降，但焊接调试与故障排查的现场需求稳定。
节能改造与「双碳」政策持续拉动需求，持证、懂设计、能带队的安装人才长期紧缺。

body: 太阳能光热安装工技术员负责太阳能集热系统的安装、调试与维保，完成集热器吊装、管路连接、水箱与控制系统配置等作业，是新能源供热水与采暖领域的技术安装岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你算集热面积、排管路、报故障，但把集热板架上屋顶、把管路焊严实的，还得是安装工。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can handle navigation, but operators still make command and emergency decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 40,700 captains, mates, and ship pilots were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 40,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 4,300 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $85,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace captains and vessel operators, but it will reduce manual steering. Electronic navigation and collision-avoidance systems take over some operations, shifting mariners from steering toward decision-making, command, emergency response, and legal responsibility. Pure helmsmen face replacement, while people who command and accept responsibility become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent route optimization
Collision warnings
Weather-based route recommendations
Berthing assistance
ai_s2_auto: Electronic navigation
Automatic collision avoidance
Dynamic positioning
Automatic track recording
ai_s3_list: Command decisions: people issue the orders.
Emergency judgment: people manage the response.
Legal responsibility: people bear accountability.
Team leadership: people lead people.
Complex waters: people provide experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Systems accelerate navigation, but command and responsibility remain human domains.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Steering actions are being replaced, not command and accountability roles. People who command and accept responsibility become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only steer face the risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin at a maritime academy and earn a certificate of competency early. Pure steering is shrinking in the AI era, so develop command skills as soon as possible.
Advance from steering to managing decisions and emergencies, and learn electronic navigation.
Highlight navigation areas and vessel-type experience and clearly state your certificate level.
Hire for steadiness and willingness to accept responsibility. Command-capable personnel deserve high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Electronic navigation is widespread.
Collision avoidance is becoming automated.
Command-capable officers are in greater demand.

body: Captains, mates, and ship pilots operate and command vessels, manage navigation and collision avoidance, oversee safety and cargo and personnel, and coordinate berthing to protect the entire waterborne journey.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can handle navigation, but operators still make command and emergency decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 导航有系统接，但决策指挥和应急，还是驾驶员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年船长、大副与船舶驾驶员在岗约 4.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.09 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.55 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代船长驾驶员，但会压缩操舵。电子导航与避障系统接管部分操作，船员从「把舵」挪向「决策、指挥、应急与法律责任」。真正被替的是只操舵的，能指挥能担责的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 航线智能优化
碰撞预警
气象航线推荐
靠泊辅助
ai_s2_auto: 电子导航
自动避障
动力定位
航迹自动记录
ai_s3_list: 决策指挥：口令靠人。
应急判断：处置靠人。
法律责任：担责靠人。
团队带领：人带人。
复杂水域：经验靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——导航被系统加速，但指挥与责任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「操舵」动作，不是「指挥担责」的岗位。能指挥、能担责的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会把舵。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 航海院校起步早考适任证，AI 时代纯操舵在缩，早点练指挥。
从「操舵」升级成「管决策 + 应急」，学电子导航。
突出航区与船型经验，写清持哪级证。
选人看稳不稳、敢不敢担。能指挥的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 导航电子化普及。
避障自动化。
能指挥的骨干更抢手。
